purpose: Teach: 見え隠れ/王位/財投/先立ち/国務省/血縁/検疫/受難

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、患者さんの体調変化の兆候を見え隠れする段階で察知します
lines.en: Ren — we catch the early signs of patient deterioration before they become obvious.
lines.style: Direct, steady certainty. Clinical but not cold. Speaks with the quiet authority of someone who has seen this pattern hundreds of times. Level eye contact.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、王位を継承するような重圧の研究を医療チームで参照しております
lines.en: Yes, we reference research on the psychological weight that our medical team handles carefully.
lines.style: Measured and thoughtful. A slight pause before continuing, as if choosing words that carry responsibility. Warm but professional. The tone of someone who takes the question seriously.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療財投に関する貴院のお考え、聞かせて下さい、先生
lines.en: Doctor, could you tell me how the hospital approaches medical resource allocation?
lines.style: Respectful, genuinely interested. Leans forward slightly. Not performing deference—actual curiosity. Slight hesitation at the start, testing whether the question is welcome.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、診察に先立ち問診を医療チームで丁寧に行います
lines.en: Yes, we conduct thorough intake interviews with our medical team before any examination.
lines.style: Clear procedural statement. Not rigid—there's care in the methodicalness. Slightly slower pace, as if explaining something important. Reassuring without being condescending.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 米国国務省主催の医療会議に貴院、招かれたんですね、先生
lines.en: Doctor, the hospital was invited to that international medical conference, wasn't it?
lines.style: Tentative admiration underneath. Not quite asking a question—more like confirming something he's picked up on. Respectful. A note of genuine interest in what that means for the hospital.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、血縁ドナーによる移植を医療チームで扱います
lines.en: Yes, our medical team handles blood-related donor transplants with appropriate protocols.
lines.style: Factual, precise. The words chosen with clinical care. Not detached—there's weight in how seriously this is taken. Measured breathing, calm delivery.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 感染症の検疫体制を貴院、ご強化されてますね、先生
lines.en: Doctor, the hospital has really strengthened its infectious disease protocols lately, hasn't it?
lines.style: Observant, reflective tone. Not questioning competence—noting it with quiet respect. Thoughtful pacing. The careful voice of someone noticing something important and wondering what it means.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、受難中の患者さんに寄り添う医療を医療チームで提供します
lines.en: Yes, we provide compassionate care that walks alongside our patients through difficult treatment.
lines.style: Tender certainty. Slower pace on 'alongside.' The voice softens slightly—this is what matters most to her. Not tired, but carrying the weight of what that means. Genuine.
